sample_unit: patients with Hashimoto's thyroiditis (plus 2 endocrinologists) rating 20 questions

links.outcome: Patient clarity/satisfaction ratings versus physician accuracy ratings of LLM answers
links.effect: Patients rated ChatGPT-5 clarity 9.15 and satisfaction 8.93 out of 10, while physician accuracy ratings were 5.90 and 5.70/10 (exploratory, n=2, kappa 0.12).
links.quote: Owing to the small physician sample (n=2) and low inter-rater agreement (κ=0.12; accuracy intraclass correlation coefficient=0.48), physician accuracy ratings (5.90 and 5.70/10) are exploratory and do not support a robust patient-physician comparison.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing patient and physician evaluations of LLM responses (ChatGPT-5 vs DeepSeek V3.1) regarding Hashimoto's thyroiditis, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
